chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: Verily, Allah, the Exalted, did not prescribe for women a Qada (make-up) of fasting, nor fasting other than the fasting of Ramadan, except if it is a vow, or expiation fasting, or voluntary fasting.
ai.seo_question: Do women need to make up missed Ramadan fasts?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the juristic consensus that women are exempt from making up missed obligatory fasts of Ramadan due to menstruation or postpartum bleeding, distinguishing this from the general rule for men. This ruling underscores the principle of *rukhas* (divine concessions) in Shia fiqh, where physiological states relieve women of the strict *qada* (make-up) obligation for the primary pillar, while maintaining their accountability for specific vows or expiations they voluntarily undertook.
